title: From repo URL to full understanding.
subtitle: Our AI pipeline transforms any GitHub repository into an interactive knowledge base in under 60 seconds.

steps.title: Connect & Import
steps.headline: Paste any GitHub URL
steps.description: Drop in a public or private repository URL. We shallow-clone the repository and detect the branch, language, and project structure automatically.

steps.title: Parse & Build Graph
steps.headline: AST-powered code intelligence
steps.description: Every file is parsed using tree-sitter AST extractors. We identify classes, functions, imports, and call relationships — then compile them into a unified JSON dependency graph.

steps.title: Vectorless RAG
steps.headline: No embeddings. Pure graph traversal.
steps.description: Unlike traditional RAG, we don't use vector embeddings. Instead, our AST Router uses an LLM to identify entry-point files, then walks the dependency graph (BFS) to gather context. Depth-1 files get full source code; Depth-2 files get AST signatures only.

steps.title: Multi-Agent Pipeline
steps.headline: Supervisor routes to specialists
steps.description: A LangGraph supervisor classifies your intent and routes to the right specialist agent: Code QA for questions, Visualizer for Mermaid diagrams, Blast Radius for impact analysis, or Repo Summary for overviews.
steps.codePreview: workflow: START → supervisor → {QA, VISUALIZE, IMPACT, GUARDRAIL, REPO_SUMMARY} → END

steps.title: Explore & Understand
steps.headline: Chat, visualize, analyze
steps.description: Get answers with precise file citations and line numbers. View auto-generated architecture diagrams. Analyze the blast radius of code changes. All streamed in real-time with BYOK multi-model choice.
